rows.title: Price movement
rows.summary: Significant movement in price has been observed in BMW Ventures Limited. The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the company. BMW Ventures Limited has submitted their response.

rows.headline: The Company has attached a clarification regarding the price movement.
rows.subject: Clarification Regarding The Price Movement
